title: Monthly Decline Rate
scenario: Calculate the decline rate (declined transactions / total transactions) for each month. Return the result table as 'month' and 'decline_rate' (rounded to 2 decimal places).
tableSchema: transactions (id INT, country VARCHAR, state VARCHAR, amount INT, trans_date DATE)
hint: Use AVG(state = 'declined') to calculate the percentage.
correctQuery: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', trans_date) AS month, ROUND(AVG(state = 'declined'), 2) AS decline_rate FROM transactions GROUP BY month;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE transactions (id INT, country VARCHAR, state VARCHAR, amount INT, trans_date DATE); INSERT INTO transactions VALUES (1, 'US', 'approved', 1000, '2019-01-01'), (2, 'US', 'declined', 500, '2019-01-05');
